_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Berkeley City College, second read. The first (berkeley_city_capture_words, run 43138099241) found the rendered view pages (.../catalog/view//iq/...) now send the reader to a sign-in page ('Please provide the reason you are requesting access to CurriQunet Meta'), so this read takes each program page through the catalog's own JSON as the capture does (cq_view, catalog 10327). The first read's top navigation names 'Degree and Certificate Requirements' node 40739 and 'Transfer Information' node 40736, each with one child list; this read lists both and prints each node's own page. Pages: English AA-T 31138 (40014), Biology AS-T 41902 (40061), American Sign Language A.A. 01101 (39977), Fundamentals of Data Science A.S. 45941 (41937). No model call.

questions.ge_node: Which child pages of Degree and Certificate Requirements (40739) and Transfer Information (40736) are the Cal-GETC page, the local A.A./A.S. general education pattern and the associate degree requirements?
questions.adt_words: What exactly does a transfer page print for general education, electives and the degree total, as the capture reads it?
questions.local_words: What exactly does a local degree page print for general education, electives and the degree total, and does it name a GE pattern or a minimum or double-count rule?
questions.ge_units: Does either section page print the units of Cal-GETC or of the local general education pattern, or a minimum-60 or electives sentence?
